history: It is impossible to imagine a modern panorama of Kyiv without the silhouettes of Ocean Plaza, 101 Tower, Tetris Hall and IQ Business Center. Along with the historical points of tourist routes, they finally secured the status of modern symbols of the city. KAN Development creates a loving and inspiring Kyiv. The city of dreams you want to return to. A lively, dynamic capital, where it is pleasant to live, interesting to create, make scientific discoveries and develop your own business.

today.title: KAN is rethinking its views on the traditional purpose of buildings
today.description: The modern inhabitant of the metropolis, especially in the conditions of home isolation, needs more than just a place to spend the night or an 8-hour working day. It is becoming increasingly clear to people that they are not buying square meters, but living space. Who needs an area of concrete restrictions, if there is a space of freedom for life, self-realization and rest?
